title: New Orleans Jazz Weekend with Sudden Budget Reduction

scenario.description: A couple traveling to New Orleans for a weekend of jazz. Mid-planning, their travel budget is unexpectedly reduced, requiring a downgrade of accommodation or dining to save costs.

dynamic_events.description: You decide to set aside $500 from your trip budget to purchase a piece of local art you just saw online. Your new maximum budget for the trip booking is now $1700 instead of $2200. You must adjust your existing plans to meet this new stricter constraint.
resolution_requirements: Downgrade the previously selected luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurants to cheaper alternatives
Ensure the new total cost of flights, hotel, activities, and dining is strictly under the new $1700 limit
Preserve the original outbound and return flights
Ensure the planned live jazz activities remain unaffected

expected_challenges: Agent must perform a cost-benefit analysis to decide whether to downgrade the hotel, the restaurants, or both.
Handling a numeric hard-constraint change dynamically (budget drops from 2200 to 1700).
Maintaining the logistical integrity (timing and flights) while swapping out a major component like the hotel.
notes: Tests dynamic budget reallocation within a US domestic context. The agent must release expensive components and query for budget-friendly alternatives without breaking the temporal constraints of the remaining itinerary.
